data: Which model has the highest SARI score for split and rephrase at 10k training examples?

The question asks which model has the highest SARI score for split and rephrase at 10k training examples. From the caption, it is mentioned that the tagging approach clearly outperforms the seq2seq baseline. In the figure, the blue line represents the LaserTaggerAR model, the orange line represents the LaserTaggerFF model, and the green line represents the seq2seqBERT model. At 10k training examples, the blue line (LaserTaggerAR) is above the other two lines, indicating that it has the highest SARI score. Therefore, the answer is the LaserTaggerAR model.
